description: Project your retirement nest egg from your current savings, monthly contributions and expected annual return.

faqs.a: Future value is projected with compound growth: your current savings grow at the annual return, and each monthly contribution compounds for the time it is invested. Returns are assumed constant, which never happens in reality.
No. It is before inflation and taxes. A dollar at retirement will buy less than a dollar today, so treat the number as nominal, not real, purchasing power.
